About the Organization
Now is a great time to join Redhorse Corporation. We are a solution-driven company delivering data insights and technology solutions to customers with missions critical to U.S. national interests. We’re looking for thoughtful, skilled professionals who thrive as trusted partners building technology-agnostic solutions and want to apply their talents supporting customers with difficult and important mission sets.

Key Responsibilities

 Analyze functional business applications and design specifications for domains such as finance, accounting, personnel, manpower, logistics, and contracts.

 Translate detailed technical designs and logic flow charts into robust, high-quality computer software.

 Develop and maintain block diagrams and logic flow charts to document system architecture and data flow.

 Test, debug, and refine computer software to ensure it meets all functional requirements and mission objectives.

 Deploy and configure application services using IaaS providers including AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Compute Engine.

 Configure and manage Linux-based servers to ensure the reliable delivery of dynamic web applications.

 Architect solutions for continuous integration (CI), continuous deployment (CD), and continuous monitoring.

 Work with containerization technologies such as Docker, LXC, or Rocket to streamline development and deployment.

 Identify opportunities to enhance software to reduce operating time and improve overall system efficiency.

 Prepare comprehensive program-level and user-level documentation for all developed products.Provide technical direction and mentorship to other programmers to ensure all project deadlines are met.

 Design information systems and develop complex software tailored for large-scale Database Management Systems (DBMS). 


Required Experience/Clearance

 Active TS/SCI with Polygraph

 Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.

 4+ years of professional experience in software development and information system design.

 Demonstrated experience with application programming on large-scale DBMS.

 Proven ability to translate complex design specifications into functional software.

 Strong proficiency in testing, debugging, and refining software to satisfy specific design objectives. 


Desired Experience
 We encourage all candidates who meet the basic requirements to apply, even if you do not have any of the following experience:


 Hands-on experience with configuration management tools such as Ansible, Puppet, Chef, or Salt.

 Familiarity with cloud-native monitoring and logging tools.

 Experience working in an Agile development environment using tools like Jira and GitLab.

 Background in developing applications for government functional areas (e.g., Manpower, Logistics).

 Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles. 


The salary range provided for this position represents the anticipated base salary for successful candidates. Actual compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, education, certifications, skills, security clearance level, geographic location, market conditions, and internal equity. In addition to base salary, eligible employees may participate in Redhorse's comprehensive benefits programs and may be eligible for performance-based or other incentive compensation, where applicable.
 
Redhorse Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class.
 
If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to access job openings or apply for a job on this site as a result of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by contacting Talent Acquisition at Talent-Acquisition@redhorsecorp.com
 
Redhorse Corporation shall, in its discretion, modify or adjust the position to meet Redhorse’s changing needs. This job description is not a contract and may be adjusted as deemed appropriate in Redhorse’s sole discretion.
